messages:
ida: FYI CI went red after I regenerated poetry.lock for my deps bump PR. Unit tests fail in tests/integration/test_ratelimit.py, looks like an import error in urllib3. buildkite: https://buildkite.com/redwood/infra/builds/6721
ci-bot: buildkite/unit-tests failed — 12 failing tests. log excerpt below.
sam: can you paste the traceback?
ida: sure, here it is:
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tests/integration/test_ratelimit.py", line 42, in test_backoff
    from urllib3.util.retry import Retry
ImportError: cannot import name 'Retry' from 'urllib3.util.retry'
```
maria: hmm that smells like a transitive bump. which package pulled a newer urllib3? run `poetry show --tree | sed -n '/urllib3/,+2p'` or `poetry export -f requirements.txt --without-hashes | grep urllib3`
ida: ran `poetry show --tree | grep -C2 urllib3` locally — shows requests -> urllib3 2.0.0 (from requests 2.31.0) but our code expects the old path.
raj: ok likely upstream changed layout in urllib3 2.x. quick options: pin urllib3 to 1.x in pyproject, or add an explicit resolution in the lockfile. we should bisect the lock regenerate to find which package upgrade pulled it in.
sam: can someone run the lockfile-bisect script? `scripts/lockfile_bisect.sh HEAD~5 HEAD -- pytest tests/integration/test_ratelimit.py`
ida: starting bisect now, will paste result.
ci-bot: note — avoid force-updating all transitive deps in patch releases, prefer targeted bumps.
ida: bisect result: failure introduced when bumping `requests` 2.30.0 -> 2.31.0 (transitively brought urllib3 2.0.0).
maria: thanks — so the immediate fix is to add an explicit dependency constraint: `urllib3 = "^1.26.0"` in pyproject.toml and regenerate lock. that keeps requests at latest but forces urllib3 compat. alternative: pin requests back to 2.30.x but that seems worse.
sam: +1 to explicit constraint, but let's also add a test that imports Retry directly so this regression fails fast.
raj: I'll open a follow-up PR with pyproject change + lock regen and run CI. please @ida validate locally with `poetry lock --no-update` then `poetry install --no-root` and `pytest tests/integration/test_ratelimit.py` before pushing.
ida: reproduces locally after adding constraint, tests pass. pushed PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4312 — rerunning CI.
ci-bot: triggered rebuild of unit-tests for PR #4312.
ci-bot: buildkite/unit-tests passed.
ida: awesome, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
maria: follow-up: I'll add a short note in the release checklist to flag major transitive bumps of core infra libs (urllib3, cryptography, httpx) so we can be more cautious in bulk lock regenerations.
sam: also adding a small lint in `eng-infra` to run `poetry show urllib3` after lock regen and fail if major bump detected.
ida: closing the loop — CI green, merging now.
